MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing fits my small electronics work because it would help insulate exposed connections and keep wiring organized.",
    "The solder seal connectors could help turn a prototype into a permanent wired assembly if they fit my wires, while the caliper would help check component and mounting dimensions."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The three filament choices assume I have a compatible 3D printer and a printing project, neither of which is established by my electronics purchases.",
    "The heavy battery lugs do not match my small wiring projects, and the feeler gauge and thick acrylic sheet need specific uses I do not currently have.",
    "Another caster set feels unnecessary after my recent purchase of casters with leg levelers."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in making small electronic assemblies seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for 3D printing supplies.",
    "Electrical and workshop items seem to be treated as related without enough attention to wire size, intended use, or whether I already bought something that fills the need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, relay module, and PCB kit point toward small component assembly, where insulation, suitable connections, and dimensional checks have practical value.",
    "A recent purchase can mean a need has been filled; my caster purchase does not by itself mean I want more casters.",
    "Specialized supplies only appeal to me when I have the equipment or a specific project that requires them."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small electronics work but extended it too far into unrelated supplies and an already filled caster need."
}
